title: Barrier Breaker - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Barrier Breaker in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

facts.label: Location

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Barrier Breaker is a void-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Defense (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Barrier Breaker
sections.content:
Location: Main quest - after the second Axon, talk to the Curator.

Main quest - after the second Axon, talk to the Curator.

sections.title: Is the Barrier Breaker Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (B), Agility (C). A dedicated void pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
